Prevention hardening (follow-up to 143-F / stash 0115F71F): close the non-ShipShipment paths that can produce archived_status: shipped without a durable shipment_status_changed: shipped event. Two complementary guards: (1) universally reject generic shipment -> shipped status transitions performed outside the ShipShipment envelope (e.g. via UpdateArtifactWithGate / generic move_item/update_item when formal enforcement is off); (2) make ArchiveItem refuse to stamp archived_status: shipped on a shipment that lacks a shipped event (or require it to route through ShipShipment). 143-F ships the durable-append + report-only doctor DETECTION net (which already flags any such residue regardless of how produced); this item is the PREVENTION complement raised by the Architecture Strategist plan-review persona and the adversarial multi-model review (reviewers A and C). Scope-deferred from 143-F to respect the audit-log-completeness bug boundary (Scope Boundary Auditor considered prevention out of scope for the bug). Ref: docs/exec-plans/2026-08-16-shipment-shipped-event-audit-log-plan.md; docs/reviews/2026-08-16-shipment-shipped-event-audit-log-adversarial-review.md.
